:::{#exm-predictive-model}
#### Polynomials as predictive models

The polynomials of @exm-prediction-function-family are a [predictive model](#def-predictive-model) when we choose among them by their [prediction error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-error) on [new observations](#def-new-observation).
They are not a [scientific model](estimation.qmd#def-scientific-model) of the outcome:
a polynomial of high degree can [predict](prediction.qmd#def-prediction) well without describing any physical condition or change.

:::
